# Mist: one low flat wisp 2.6 x 0.9 x 0.26 m (a game bone pool drifts them along the far bank).
# Origin at its centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Mist --base-color 0.8667 0.8314 0.7961 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Mist --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --location 0 0 0
scale 2.6 0.9 0.26
apply --scale
material assign Mist
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.04 --seed 3
mode object
shade flat
export mist.glb
